messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx/timeouts on /v1/generate (us-west-2). p95 jumped ~120ms -> 5.2s, p99 -> 12s. 5xx rate ~8% over the last 2m. Suspected rollout: release 2026.3.21 (kvmux keepalive header patch).
Mike O.: oncall here, acknowledging. Paging in 30s and pulling traces.
Anna R.: which change specifically? can we gate to canary?
Deploy Bot: Release 2026.3.21 deployed: kvmux v2.4 (keepalive/conn header tweak). Rollout timeline: 10% @7067889000 -> 100% @7067889300.
Devon: seeing repeated connection resets from kvmux proxies: logs show "connection reset after keepalive" and lots of inflight stalls. Sample from proxy: ```
[proxy] 2026-03-21T14:01:05Z kvmux: stream-hang conn=0x7f3; state=KEEPALIVE; latency=5123ms
[proxy] 2026-03-21T14:01:06Z kvmux: upstream reset id=42 code=ECONNRESET
```
Li (SRE): I can run a targeted rollback of the kvmux image on the rollout group. If this is the keepalive change it's the highest-prob signal. Starting rollback now.
Carmen (CS): multiple customers opening support tickets citing 502/504 and timeouts during generation calls. Noted customer IDs: acct-4812, acct-9901, acct-4220. They're seeing failures for long prompts.
Tom (oncall): if rollback doesn't fix immediately, plan B: flip traffic to older gateway (route fallback) and reduce multiplex window to 1.
Mike O.: running quick health checks: curl -sS -D - https://usw2.api.redwood/v1/generate -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n' returns: ```502 5.21\n``` will watch metrics.
Devon: adding trace snippets: traces show KV cache warmup coinciding with keepalive expiry, many requests pile up waiting for conn reuse. Possibly the new header prevents proper reuse.
Deploy Bot: rollback command executed by Li at 7067890023: revert-release --id=2026.3.20 --service=kvmux --region=us-west-2 --scope=rollout-group-3
Li (SRE): rollback completed (image pinned to 2026.3.20). Rolling out prev image across group, monitoring.
Mike O.: metrics: p95 dropping -> 180ms, p99 -> 900ms, 5xx -> 1.2% at 7067890100. Still some tail.
Devon: pushing a temporary fix to gateway: reduce keepalive window and force close idle after 30s as a mitigation if we see oscillation.
Carmen (CS): notifying affected customers now with an ETA; status page updated.
Anna R.: create a postmortem ticket — include regression test for keepalive header and a synthetic that exercises long multi-kv prompts.
Tom (oncall): handoff: I'm clear to stop pager at 7067890200. Anna will own follow-up and communication.
Mike O.: final check: p95=110ms p99=420ms error rate <0.3% at 7067890240. Closing active mitigation. :thumbsup: 
Carmen (CS): filing customer follow-ups and sending summary to acct contacts.
Anna R.: assigned follow-ups: add e2e for kvmux keepalive, add traffic-shift playbook, and run post-deploy soak on canary for 30m.
incident-bot: Incident resolved by rollback and gateway mitigation. Postmortem required.
